description: DETTEF crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C16 H22 Gd2 N4 O20,2(C2 H3 N1). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.848-3.848 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 113.68-113.68°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula {Gd2(L)2(NO3)4(H2O)2}·2(CH3CN) (HL = 2,6-dimethoxyphenol). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 4 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
